Government Cuts Customs Duty on Electronics Components to Boost Manufacturing

The Indian government has reduced the basic customs duty on essential components used in electronics manufacturing. This decision is part of a larger strategy to encourage domestic production and enhance the country's manufacturing capabilities. The move aims to make manufacturing more competitive and potentially lower costs for consumers.
